story.title: Food Fit
paragraphs_en: What will we eat for dinner Ma? Can we eat Dosa for breakfast? Daadi, please make maal puas this Sunday! I just love Sabudaana Khichdi! We have often asked or said the same to our Mother, Grandmother and Father too. WE ALL LOVE To EAT.

Chandu's Dadi makes yummy Sambhaar - Rice. But Chandu and all of us (his friends) like her Coconut Barfi the most. It has coconut and lots of other nuts. Chandu's Dadi says coconut has Vitamin E that helps us in fighting against diseases. It builds our immune system and keeps our skin healthy too.

Mother makes delicious Sabudaana Khichdi. She makes it early in the morning for breakfast. She adds diced potatoes, grated carrots, coriander and extra peanuts in it for me. Mother says it is rich in protein and will strengthen my muscles and bone.

Tinu and Minu - the twins. Oh, they are really lucky! Their Nana is a home baker. She bakes the yummiest of cakes and pastries. Do you know she can also make spinach muffins? Spinach in Muffins - who could even think of that! Nana says Spinach is rich in iron and lots of vitamins. It is good for our blood and bone health.

Vaani's Appa is very fond of eating bananas. He gifts bananas to people on all occasions. Vaani's Appa says bananas have fibre and are very good for our digestive system. It is loaded with essential vitamins and minerals like potassium. I like banana because it is sweet.

Father buys lots of vegetables from the market. They are of various colours - Green, Orange, White, Brown and even Purple. Brinjal is his favourite vegetable. He says brinjals are rich in antioxidants which keeps our arteries and heart healthy.

Mother keeps her kitchen cabinet stocked with various things of different colours. There are pulses, rice, nuts, oil, masala and many more things. Mother says our food should be wholesome. It is necessary to have a combination of different forms of food to give our body the right nutrients.

Teacher says different colour fruits, vegetables and pulses have different benefits. She showed us the Food Colour Chart in class today. She said portions of our meal should consist of Body Building, Energy Giving and Protective foods.

Grandfather insists that vegetables and fruits are best when eaten fresh. He loves to grow his own food. He along with Grandmother grow vegetables in their small kitchen garden. I often help him in maintaining the kitchen garden.
It is always good to have a fresh hot home-cooked meal.
Too much of fried and junk food can harm our stomach and growth.
But an ice cream treat once in a while shared with friends is fun. And Guess What? Mother loves ice cream too!
